receiver.placement: Flat held-stand hypothesis: engine attachment height plus 0.17 m placement clearance. Plane is horizontal in engine-root frame; only pitched/yawed nozzle moves.
receiver.opaquePlane: Only incident directions with positive world Y contribute. Below-plane gas is excluded even when the free-jet support crosses the receiver.

integration.gas: Cosine-weighted upper-hemisphere Hammersley quadrature: E_rgb = pi/N sum L_rgb; transfer j/kappa integrated only for exterior s>=0 and truncated by nearest full-engine opaque triangle.
integration.hardware: Authored one-sided hot triangle quadrature: E_rgb=sum L_rgb cos(receiver) cos(source) dA/r^2 times exterior-gas transmittance, blocked by any nearer opaque triangle. Core and liner use their own native temperatures.
integration.gasAndMetalScope: No internal-gas radiation included. No internal gas attenuation of metal rays. This is the requested existing exterior gas + visible hardware diagnostic; interior participation remains omitted.
integration.reflection: L_deck,rgb = rho E_rgb/pi; no double count of existing runtime PointLight; no ambient/sky/reflected-engine illumination.

display.projection: Orthographic plan-view radiance map; +x is right, +z is down. Nearest-neighbor display enlargement does not add samples.
display.mapping: Linear physical RGB/reference * 2^EV, IEC sRGB encoding, clip to [0,1], black ambient background; no tone mapper, no camera/NIR model.

errors: 3 selected probes exceed 3% angular / 1% path / 5% hardware refinement criteria
limits: Offline CPU receiver calculation; no runtime fixture, Babylon rendering, GPU validation or timing claim.
Native bath, particle loading/spectrum and grey hardware emissivity remain uncalibrated F135 hypotheses. Receiver rho=.2 is a declared ideal surface, not measured carrier deck reflectance.
Reflectance is not heating: no deck temperature, reradiation, material response, particle deposition, plume impingement/recovery or added gas energy is calculated.
The free-jet field is clipped at the plane for radiation only; it is not a solved wall jet. Source-cell thermal state below the plane is not reflected back into the gas.
Images use bounded coarse quadrature; selected-probe refinement does not prove every pixel converged. CSV/probes retain raw units independently of fixed display exposure.
Actual hot-shutdown record is horizontal; the downward comparison deliberately reposes its unchanged native temperatures, with gas off according to actual zero fuel.
